notes: `tweet.id` is a NOT NULL primary key in the catalog, but it sits on the inner (right) side of a LEFT JOIN, so every unmatched left row is null-extended and the column becomes nullable. The join condition is literally `false`, so *no* row ever matches and the NULL is unavoidable. This is the canonical demonstration that catalog nullability is a lower bound only: an engine that reports NOT NULL here is UNSOUND, not merely imprecise.
